text:
alice: Heads-up — I'm planning to toggle the runtime pin for runtime-v3.4 on our canary pool tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Observed a perf regression in longseq workloads; we think an ABI mismatch with the latest SDK is the likely cause.
ben: thanks. is this a soft pin (deploybot toggle) or full pinlist add?
alice: soft toggle via deploy-bot first so we can observe. not adding to pinlist unless metrics fail.
deploy-bot: @alice requested: TOGGLE_PIN runtime-v3.4 scope=canary scheduled=2026-03-22T08:00:00Z. Current status: pending. Use `deploy-bot status 1796500000` to follow.
carla: can we confirm which SDK versions are in the wild? ryan reported some clients still on sdk-2.7. If so we should warn them to upgrade or keep region on older runtime.
ryan: confirmed: about 12% of production requests come from sdk-2.7; most internal infra upgraded to sdk-3.x. I can open a quick compat advisory to customers.
qa: what are the specific failure modes you saw? logs?
alice: two things: 1) rare tokenization drift on multilingual long inputs causing context mismatch, 2) 99th percentile latency increase ~25% on >8k tokens. Reproducible on a few canary jobs.
ben: can you paste the failing trace?
alice: Sure — snippet: ```
E 2026-03-20T16:02:11Z runtime-v3.4 kvcache: mismatch len=2048 expected=2047
W 2026-03-20T16:02:11Z sdk-compat: found pinshim_v2 behavior mismatch
```
carla: ACK. Plan idea: toggle pin in canary, run 6h smoke with canary traffic at 5% -> 15% -> 25% if stable, with automatic rollback trigger on error rate >0.5% or latency regression >15%.
ben: add the metric checks to deploy-bot runbook. also add telemetry snapshot of kvcache hit/miss and tokenization diffs.
deploy-bot: RUNBOOK for 1796500000:
  - step 1: toggle_pin runtime-v3.4 scope=canary -> status PENDING
  - step 2: ramp schedule 5m:0.05, 1h:0.15, 3h:0.25
  - step 3: auto-rollback if (error_rate > 0.5%) OR (p99_latency > baseline_p99 * 1.15)
  - step 4: notify #incidents and ops-oncall on rollback
  - manual abort: `deploy-bot abort 1796500000`
ops-oncall: are we comfortable with that rollback threshold? it seems tight but safe.
ryan: tight is fine. ops-oncall, if we see widespread kvcache mismatch we should move traffic off runtime-v3.4 and pin to runtime-v3.3 globally.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll standby and prepare a fast pin command: `deploy-bot pinlist add runtime-v3.3 --reason "runtime-v3.4 regressions"`
carla: we should also tag any failing requests with sdk version so we can attribute. qa, can you enable enhanced logging for canary window?
qa: enabling enhanced logs for canary group now. will capture token diffs and kvcache traces for next 12h.
alice: I'll attach short release notes for the toggle in the rollback ticket: - reason: latency + tokenization drift; - scope: canary; - metrics to watch: p99 latency, kvcache mismatch rate, tokenization mismatch count; - rollback plan: auto + manual pin to v3.3.
ryan: I'll prep a customer advisory for customers on sdk-2.7 to upgrade to sdk-3.0+; include mitigations (pin to runtime-v3.3) and ETA for full unpin.
ben: one more ask — add a small canary test set to Redwood Optimize to evaluate quality diffs (prompt set ~120 cases) during ramp.
carla: done, scheduled. results will be posted to the thread.
deploy-bot: UPDATE 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z: toggle window opened for review. Waiting for final thumbs.
alice: thumbs from me. scheduling for 08:00 UTC as planned.
ryan: thumbs. I'll publish the advisory draft in #support-digest at 07:30 UTC.
ops-oncall: I'll be on standby during the window. Pager contact set.
ben: if anything looks off in first 30m, abort and escalate.
carla: noted. if we need to escalate, start the incident bridge with `incident start runtime-regress` and include logs link.
qa: early note — enhanced logs already show a couple of token drift examples. will attach to ticket.
alice: thanks everyone. tagging this as follow-up for release notes and postmortem if rollback occurs.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED 1796500000 -> 2026-03-22T08:00:00Z (UTC). Notifications will be posted in #eng-releases and #incidents upon state change.
ryan: will grab metrics snapshot before toggle + after 30m to compare.
ben: adding checklist to the release note draft and closing out preflight.
carla: good luck :rocket:
qa: will update with initial findings during ramp.
alice: end of thread for now. thanks everyone.
